identify_feature_type: identify the type of a numpy array as BINARY, PROBABILITY, ENUM, or CONTINUOUS
check_is_binary: check if a numpy array contains only binary values of 0 and 1
check_is_probability: check if a numpy array contains values between 0 and 1
check_is_enum: check if a numpy array contains positive integer values below a threshold
list_feature_types: list all supported feature type constants like BINARY, PROBABILITY, ENUM, and CONTINUOUS
